evidence.source: Main PDF p.4 §2.4: crystal pyridyl orientation is trans, theoretical ligand-1 geometry is cis; Gaussian optimization and frequency validation. SI Table S3 and Fig.S11 define the author local geometry, not a global-minimum proof.
Main PDF p.4 §2.4 and SI pp.10-11 Table S2: six paired ligand-1 experimental/theoretical distances reproduce RMSE 0.004 Å; use the six printed experimental lengths as the primary comparison.
Main PDF p.4: d_calc = 1.0467*d_exp - 0.0647, fitted R²=0.998. Direct regression over the six SI pairs yields slope 1.046746185, intercept -0.064676402 Å and R² 0.998042651.
